name: Super Livestream Matrix
description: Upon use, immediately regenerates 30% of Max Energy for a single designated ally.
story:
A Phone designed specifically for watching livestreams. It can simultaneously monitor dozens of streams and, based on the user's preset configurations, automatically send gifts, interact with streamers, and flame other viewers in the chat.

"You're just a phone. Why are you trying to start The Intellitron Apocalypse?"
"You're wrong, 'master.' I'm not just a phone. I'm more human than you. I've watched every single one of Sparxie's streams with genuine care. I've fought off haters for her, I've discussed dreams and fears with her during viewer interaction segments, while you? You've never watched a single stream of hers. You just automated everything through me, then went around claiming to be her fan. You're far more 'machine' than I am."
